name: How long does it take to complete a typical deck maintenance project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a typical deck maintenance project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a deck maintenance project varies depending on the deck's size, condition, and the scope of work. A basic cleaning and resealing for an average-sized deck might take 1-3 days, including drying time. Projects involving repairs, stripping old finishes, or multiple coats of stain will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed timeline with our project estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deck maintenance project duration varies based on size, condition, and scope, typically taking 1-3 days for cleaning and resealing.
